description: This PHP file defines the AOR_Report class which is part of the SuiteCRM project and extends Basic. It provides functionalities for creating, managing, and rendering reports, including SQL query building, CSV export, chart building, access control, and report data processing within the SuiteCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: AOR_Report
classes.description: Represents a report within SuiteCRM, handling report creation, data retrieval, chart generation, CSV export, access control, and complex SQL query construction.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates the interfaces implemented by this bean; here it always returns true for 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the report object, including associated fields, conditions, and charts, with performance considerations.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has access to perform actions on this report.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields after bean retrieval, primarily loading report beans.

methods.name: load_report_beans
methods.description: Loads report-related bean data into the report for module list management.

methods.name: getReportFields
methods.description: Retrieves linked report fields sorted by their display order.

methods.name: build_report_chart
methods.description: Constructs HTML for report charts using embedded JavaScript libraries.

methods.name: buildMultiGroupReport
methods.description: Builds a multi-level grouped report with nested groupings and HTML rendering.

methods.name: getGroupDisplayFieldByReportId
methods.description: Fetches fields used for grouping in reports by report ID and level.

methods.name: dbSelect
methods.description: Executes SQL SELECT query and fetches all results as associative arrays.

methods.name: getMultiGroupFrameHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML wrapper for multi-group sections.

methods.name: addDataIdValueToInnertext
methods.description: Modifies HTML to add data-id-value attributes into inner text.

methods.name: build_group_report
methods.description: Generates grouped report HTML with customizable offsets and links.

methods.name: build_report_html
methods.description: Builds the HTML table for a report, including pagination, headers, and rows.

methods.name: getModuleFieldByGroupValue
methods.description: Retrieves display string for a group value, fixing display on related, enum, or direct value.

methods.name: getTotalHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for total row aggregations (SUM, AVG, COUNT) in reports.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates total value based on type (SUM, AVG, COUNT) from provided data.

methods.name: encloseForCSV
methods.description: Escapes a field value for CSV output using a CSV utility class.

methods.name: build_report_csv
methods.description: Creates and outputs CSV file of report data.

methods.name: build_report_query
methods.description: Constructs the full SQL query for report data based on current report configuration and filters.

methods.name: queryWhereRepair
methods.description: Cleans up SQL WHERE clause strings to prevent syntax errors.

methods.name: build_report_query_select
methods.description: Builds the SELECT part of the report SQL, including joins and field-specific conversions.

methods.name: build_report_query_join
methods.description: Creates SQL JOIN statements for related modules.

methods.name: build_report_access_query
methods.description: Generates access control restrictions for related modules in SQL.

methods.name: build_report_query_where
methods.description: Adds filtering conditions to the SQL query based on saved report conditions.

methods.name: build_report_query_join
methods.description: Adds relational joins into the report query from relationship definitions.
